cv:

- Senior Design Engineer, Velox Robotics (2019–present): Lead designer for gripper and end-effector assemblies. cad (weight 0.4): Nine years of professional parametric CAD in SolidWorks and CadQuery, including design-table configurations for a 300-variant product line and a 40+ component CadQuery library. That is demanding, code-first parametric depth, so 5 with high confidence.

geo (0.3): GD&T on all production drawings plus tolerance stack-ups for every assembly is demanding dimensional work at the core of the job. Flexures and gear housings add to it. Score 5.

code (0.2): A reusable CadQuery library driven from YAML specs and used by 12 engineers is the top anchor for scripting, backed by Python with pytest and numpy. Score 5.

comm (0.1): They authored the team's guide to writing parametric part specs and mentor juniors on design-intent documentation, so documentation and teaching are an explicit, regular part of the work. Score 5.

Overall: a strong, well-evidenced match on every criterion. Confidence is high because each score rests on explicit statements.
